info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Consumer Investments Management API
info.description: The Consumer Investments Management API provides robust capabilities for managing and facilitating consumer investment initiatives. This endpoint allows users to create and manage investment portfolios tailored to individual consumer needs. Common use cases include financial advisors submitting investment plans on behalf of clients or consumers initiating their own investment strategy. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their financial service offerings and streamline investment processes for their customers.
